title: Loudmouth Bass Queue
description: Looking for other loudmouth bass enjoyers? Look no further! Made for finding players in Hypixel Skyblock to 1v1 in Loudmouth Bass duels.
body:
Find opponents for your Loudmouth Bass duels - automatically!

---
What is this?

A mod that matches you with other players who have the same weight Loudmouth Bass for fair duels. No more spamming chat looking for opponents!

✨ Features

- 🎯 Automatic Matchmaking - Get paired with players who have the exact same bass weight
- 🎉 Auto Party Invites - Party invite sent automatically when matched
- ⚡ Instant Matching - Find opponents in seconds
- 🔒 Always Fair - Only matches identical weights

🎮 How to Use

1. Hold your Loudmouth Bass
2. Press B to join queue
3. Wait for match notification
4. Accept party invite
5. Duel!

Press B again to leave queue.

💬 What You'll See

When a match is found:
MATCH FOUND!
Opponent: PlayerName (Bass Weight: 1 lb)
Sending party invite to PlayerName...

Just accept the invite and duel! 🏆

---
May the heavier bass win! 🐟
